title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holding steady at $77,551—flat on the day despite fear-gauge showing 33. That's genuine caution in the market.

Network health remains rock solid. Hashrate cruising at 952.9 exahashes, we're approaching block 946,667—that's 53,334 blocks from the next halving. Mempool's clean with nearly 57,000 transactions and fees bottomed out at 1 sat per byte. Settlement layer is running smooth.

The story here: price stability amid persistent fear. No capitulation, no euphoria. Institutional patienc
